summary: Selway-Bitterroot Wilderness lookout: a 1927 shake cabin, a 1931 L-4 cab, then the present 1961 R-6 cab on a 10-foot concrete base; open to the public, reached by a long hike.

access.note: Open to public use, per the National Historic Lookout Register; in the Selway-Bitterroot Wilderness.

visit.trail_note: Long hike on trails in the Selway-Bitterroot Wilderness, per an Idaho climbing guide.

events.note: An L-4 cab replaced the shake cabin.
Present R-6 cab on a 10-foot concrete base. The Forest Service statement quoted by the climbing guide says it was placed three years before wilderness designation.
Bill Moore is the one known staffer listed by Idaho Fire Lookouts.
Added to the National Historic Lookout Register; registered July 23, 2012.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and Idaho Fire Lookouts both describe the present R-6 cab on its concrete base, and neither reports its removal. The standing status in the record is kept.

sources.title: Hidden Peak - IDAHO: A Climbing Guide

notes_for_editor: History is consistent across four sources, and the 1961 date is backed by a Forest Service statement quoted in the climbing guide. Access is upgraded to public from the register's 'Open to public use'. The record's county 'Idaho' is left alone, since it follows the convention used for the other records. Current condition and staffing are not reported after 2012; the climbing guide and firelookout.com pages are undated. Forest: the register says Lolo/Clearwater National Forests and Idaho Fire Lookouts says Lolo / Clearwater National Forest, so they agree. No wilderness designation year is stated in any source, so the story gives only the 'three years' relation. No new photos recorded.
